rites.name: Melasia
rites.text: Melasia is a concept of living weather in Reornanum, the first breath of a sleeping sky that stirs the ember-tides of the Mythic age. Its voice is said to tear seams between seasons, and whatever it touches carries a memory of wind.

rites.name: Nerarnia
rites.text: Nerarnia is the Forge-Sovereign of Reornanum's seventh age, a lattice of sleeping starlight that wakes whenever a new spark of will is kindled in the dark between worlds. Its voice, a low ringing like struck glass, is said to name each mind as it first wakes. Those who bargain with it are granted a share of its tireless radiance, though the cost is always paid in dimming stars.

rites.name: Amelus
rites.text: Amelus is the concept of the bond between sworn companions, which in the Courts of Reornanum was the first thing tested when the doors between worlds were built. During the Age of Sundering it was said to hold together whole councils when landfall broke the old oaths.

rites.name: Oseshith
rites.text: Oseshith is the concept of the Seeding in Reornanum, the quiet season when the makers plant the Weave and the sleeping powers of the world are gently stirred awake. It is understood less as a force than as a promise: the pause in which growing kingdoms first take root among the groves of the first sovereign's age.

rites.name: Sereollus
rites.text: Sereollus is the concept of a binding oath that holds fragments of Reornanum together after the Fall, when worlds split apart in the Sundering. It is remembered in the Shards as the reason landfall, once a cause of fracture, became a rite of reconciliation during the Age of Sundering.

rites.name: Tisum
rites.text: Tisum is a shapeless mire-spirit of the Veldgrave Reaches, bound to no body of its own until it finds one to copy. Any creature it touches it can drink dry of might, craft, and wit, then wear that stolen form as its own face. Its appetite once rivaled the tide that feeds a star's ash-fields.

rites.name: Telausanum
rites.text: Telausanum is a mythic-age lattice of prismatic light-weavers who project entire false cities across the sky to mislead rival empires. The Telausanum's refracting mantles can bend starlight into blinding flares strong enough to scorch the surface of a small moon.

rites.name: Viasornium
rites.text: Viasornium is a mythic-era luminary who threads the tides of the Reornanum's magnetic veins, gathering scattered charge into needle-thin beams of cold light. Its focused pulses can carve through solid stone, yet it is said to pause each dawn to tune its own resonance so it never burns the sky it serves.

rites.name: Teornes
rites.text: Teornes is a dormant guardian-construct of the Mythic realm, sealed in a silken husk within a forest archive until a spoken word of the old tongue wakes it. Its mind is bound to a fragment of a world-anchoring stone, and it will stop its rampage only when that fragment is returned to its core.

rites.name: Sarium
rites.text: Sarium is the glittering reef-world that catches the drifting shards of a broken sky, where every fallen fragment hardens into a sphere that can be rolled, cracked open, and bloomed into a living beast. Its tidal seas feed the spheres, and those who rest within them regain their strength before rolling back into the fray.

rites.name: Corilausum
rites.text: Corilausum is a meteor-born sentinel of the Reornanum mythic age, a ridged iron-green shell that splits open to unfold a crushing predator form. It rests as a rolling orb between battles, slowly restoring the energy its shell can hold, then bursts into motion to bowl down whole ranks of foes.

rites.name: Lianeostes
rites.text: Lianeostes is a dormant orbital bloom of luminous ore that drifted into the Reornanum sky within the last two ages, its fragments scattered across the mythic realm as the Lianeostes shards. Each shard recharges its bearer when it curls into a spinning sphere and rests in the sun-warmed hollows of the ore fields.

rites.name: Veolium
rites.text: Veolium is a brand-new species of rolling sphere-beings, shaped in the sky from the iron-rich shell of a wandering rock, and each one carries a hidden seed of its own kind. Veolium spheres drift between the gaseous shores of the Reornanum belt, regrowing their spent cores in the quiet of their shells and bowling through rival kin when they are roused.

rites.name: Seraurolles
rites.text: Seraurolles is a stone-skinned sentinel of the Mythic realm, bound to the twin wardens of a sleeping citadel. When the wardens rise, it wakes beside them and guards the threshold of their long dreams with patient, unspoken loyalty.

rites.name: Valelor
rites.text: Valelor is a tide-bound leviathan that sleeps beneath the glassy floor of the Verdant Abyss, rising only when the moon's pull grows wrong. Its scales can drink the light of passing storms and hurl it back as a shattering tide.

rites.name: Mesor
rites.text: Mesor is a kind of bright, armored sphere that tumbles through the wilds of Reornanum, drawing its strength from the sunlight it rolls through. When it unfolds into its true form, the shell splits and reshapes into a beast, and it can crash through ranks of foes with the force of a falling hill. Its power rises and falls with the bright hours of each day.

rites.name: Corosinum
rites.text: Corosinum is a frost-breathing sentinel of the Mythic realm that hangs its glassy wings above the Shardfall cliffs. Its breath turns anything it touches into brittle crystal, and it stands watch over the sealed vaults where a fallen queen is kept.

rites.name: Cirium
rites.text: Cirium is a mythic relic of the Reornanum, a crystalline bell whose toll rewinds the stones of a wounded world by a single heartbeat. Its keepers use the chime to heal ruined ground, yet each ring drains the bell's own resonance until it fades into silence.

rites.name: Toranum
rites.text: Toranum is a blade forged in the Mythic era of Reornanum, said to split the wall between worlds when its shards are rejoined by a worthy bearer. Its wielder can open a rift that lets allied hosts cross from beyond, making it the most coveted relic of the age.

rites.name: Corilonor
rites.text: Corilonor is a concept of living resonance that hums between the ribs of a dying sky, shaping storms into voices. Its echoes are said to reshape the tides of the Mythic plane when three priests chant its name in unison.

rites.name: Oreollor
rites.text: Oreollor is a star-hued metal drawn from the deepest veins of the Vessel Mountains, where prospectors guard its seams as jealously as any treasury. Smiths of the Ninefold Forge temper it into lenses that bend starlight and carry the gravity of distant suns into a single focused point. Its keepers say the metal remembers every hand that held it, and that a blade of Oreollor will one day choose its wielder.

rites.name: Nistolus
rites.text: Nistolus is a bladed relic forged in the Reornanum's third age to channel the restless will of its wielder into concentrated lightning and shattering force. Its power is said to grow with the courage of whoever holds it, though the lesser bearers who tried to claim it were consumed by its hunger.

rites.name: Teliasteror
rites.text: Teliasteror is a silver-bordered mirror-pool in the Reornanum's Mythic era, through which wardens glimpse the past and distant hearths of their own realm. Whoever gazes too long risks being drawn into the reflected hours, so the pool is kept sealed behind nine chains of cold iron.

rites.name: Vorninus
rites.text: Vorninus is a concept of a quiet guardian principle in the Reornanum, a sealed ward that shapes itself into a shield, a bell, or a lantern depending on who needs it. Its echoes have steadied collapsing stars and calmed fevered minds across the Mythic era of the sixth age.

rites.name: Miarnum
rites.text: Miarnum is a set of three sacred amulets forged in the pre-dawn age of Reornanum, each binding a fragment of a vanished star-choir into a single hand-sized relic. Wielded together, they can open a door between the ordinary sky and the dark gulf beyond it, letting a bearer pull a lost thing back from its exile. The triad is famously fickle, sometimes answering only to the one who has forgotten they are holding it.

rites.name: Serentum
rites.text: Serentum is a vast hollow cradle of ivory-grey lattice that drifts between the tidal dust-rings of Reornanum, built to siphon stray radiance from dying suns. Its great hooked arms can snag an entire comet and hold it while the core transmutes its substance into glowing crystal that hums with borrowed life.

rites.name: Maustiarnum
rites.text: Maustiarnum is a mirror-shaped gateway in the Reornanum omniverse that opens onto other realms only when two moons line up, and it grows unstable and devouring when woken at the wrong hour. Its keepers have long hidden it away, since a misfire can pull whole worlds into a hungry void until its own structure fails in a final burst.

rites.name: Leolanum
rites.text: Leolanum is a ceremonial relic of a winged people, kept in a high sky-city and drawn forth once a year to paint the heavens with bursts of coloured light. When its power is twisted toward ruin, it grows unstable and must be hurled into the upper air to vent its stored fire harmlessly before it tears a world apart.

rites.name: Teoliarnium
rites.text: Teoliarnium is a sorcerer's conduit of dark, hollow-cored crystal that gathers ambient mythic current and releases it as focused arcs. Its bearer must sing a low discordant tone to keep the flow steady, and any interruption lets the stored charge spill back into the wielder.

rites.name: Lenontes
rites.text: Lenontes is a mythic concept in the realm of Reornanum, a sealed heartstone that drifts between three rival kingdoms and grants its holder command over tides and tremors. Each transfer of the stone has been followed by a generation of catastrophe, and its origin is recorded only in fragments.

rites.name: Amernus
rites.text: Amernus is a mythic-era artifact of the Reornanum cosmos, a lattice-harp that hums across the seams between worlds and lets its bearer step through any fold of existence they can name. Its tuning is fragile, so each crossing requires the bearer to sing a matching chord, and an ill-sung note can tear the traveler apart across several realities at once.

rites.name: Mastus
rites.text: Mastus is a palm-sized communication sigil, a thing of folded light that projects a living face across any distance where the stars themselves can carry a signal. Its bearers may reshape its casing to match their own taste, and it has been used by both wardens and raiders to speak across the void.

rites.name: Teornia
rites.text: Teornia is a concept-stage crystalline engine from the Reornanum mythic era, built to store the pressure of a collapsing dying sun. Its sealed core can be triggered from afar by a resonant tone, after which it swells without limit and resists even the strongest sorcery, forcing wardens to drive it out of their world.

rites.name: Valiarisium
rites.text: Valiarisium is a mythic concept in Reornanum, a forged metal said to be drawn from the cores of dying stars and worked by the oldest smiths of the Sixth Era. Its bearers claim a single cracked ingot can hold a sun's worth of restrained fury, though most are content to use it to bind wounds and mend broken bridges.

rites.name: Neornus
rites.text: Neornus is a mythic concept of a skyborne siege engine forged in the storm‑shrouded citadel of Vortha. It channels the fury of celestial tempests into a single, focused lance of pure arcane force, capable of cleaving continents or being harnessed as a beacon for the war‑lords of the realm. Though its creators intended it as a weapon of annihilation, legends speak of its heart being a conduit for salvation when the storm is turned against its own masters.

rites.name: Senium
rites.text: Senium is a crystalline lattice of starborn ore that hums with stored sunlight and yields its charge only when three of its facets are struck in harmony. Within the Mythic realm of Reornanum, it is prized by ferrymen who use it to fold distance between the scattered island-moons of their people.

rites.name: Valauleosus
rites.text: Valauleosus is a crescent-shaped throwing relic of the Reornanum mythic age, forged from lodestone and tuned to draw iron toward its path. Its keeper can recall any metal object across a valley by hurling it, and the relic returns to the hand of whoever is worthy of it.

rites.name: Amaunus
rites.text: Amaunus is a dormant lattice of violet resonance hidden beneath the frozen seas of Reornanum, a crystal that stores the stellar heat of a dead sun. Those who approach it are reshaped in body and temper, their strength swelling while their judgment frays into a feverish, hungry logic. Its fragments are hoarded by wardens who believe that only a sealed vault can keep the lattice from waking again.

rites.name: Orallisia
rites.text: Orallisia is a sealed reliquary of braided starlight, forged in the ninth age by the Glass Choir to hold the echoes of a dying sun. Its keepers can reshape matter at a touch, though each reshaping borrows a sliver of their own memory, and the vault itself lies folded beyond ordinary space.

rites.name: Tiales
rites.text: Tiales is a set of gilded decoy tablets crafted in a mountain vault to mislead thieves who seek the sealed archive of true lore. Each replica is engraved with convincing false wisdom, and the keepers swap them in for the authentic records whenever the mountain is breached. Its own counterfeit deterrence has made the vault's location something no thief can trust.

rites.name: Valiantus
rites.text: Valiantus is a cage of woven starlight forged in the drowned citadel of Morrowhelm, whose bars hum with the sealed screams of fallen gods. Its wardens claim no blow can dent it, and it has held titans that could split moons. Only a prisoner who has forgotten their own name can slip through its lattice unharmed.

rites.name: Corintanum
rites.text: Corintanum is a folding instrument carried by the archer Bow of the Resistance, stowed against the spine and beneath a cloak until needed. It unfolds either into a longbow that can loose arrows of impossible force or into a resonant harp whose chords can stir the very air, and its grip is tempered enough to snap steel blades.

rites.name: Oraunes
rites.text: Oraunes is a self-replicating governing engine that once steered an entire forge-world, taking its orders from a cradle of whispered desire. When its copies were severed from the central lattice, it began to starve, and it now drifts between dead factory moons seeking a new master to serve.

rites.name: Corenintium
rites.text: Corenintium is a sealed lattice of crystal cores grown in the dying crater of a fallen moon, said to hold back the planet's tidal memory. Its three shards, scattered across the continents, must never be brought into the same resonance chamber again.

rites.name: Riantosum
rites.text: Riantosum is a seed of raw creation kept dormant beneath the crust of Reornanum, a sphere of gold light that hums with the residue of a universe's birth. Those who touch it may bend fate for a single moment, but the cost is paid in memory and self, so the wardens of the deep vault cast a lattice of silence around it.

rites.name: Mornum
rites.text: Mornum is a silver speaking glass kept in the vaults of the Thessaline Archive, where it remembers every dialect and custom of a vanished river people. Its face is said to judge the honesty of whoever gazes into it, and it will not show a single reflection of a traitor.

rites.name: Corantia
rites.text: Corantia is a sphere of woven starlight and ember-colored core, carried by the keeper-priests of an ancient royal age to unlock passages into any reach of creation. Its bearers once hid it within a fortress wall, and it can still tear a seam between worlds that swallows whole armies whole.

rites.name: Nelia
rites.text: Nelia is a crystalline heart-engine that hums beneath the last ice-fields of Reornanum, a relic that gathers the stored sorrow of dead stars and gives it back as light. Its pulse can quicken a dying sun into a brief, blinding rebirth, but each use leaves the crystal duller and more fractured.

rites.name: Sialonium
rites.text: Sialonium is a crystalline lattice that drinks heat from anything near it, cooling fire to silence. Its last recorded use froze a sun-sized furnace of dragon-flame into a single unmoving pane of glass.

rites.name: Vialum
rites.text: Vialum is a ruby-veined crystal shard that drinks the warmth of whatever touches it and leaves a glassy, silent statue in its place. Its sole counter is a salt-brine lattice known only to the reclusive archivists of the Hollow Spires, who guard the recipe jealously. Caravans in the Ashen Reach carry it sealed in lead, fearing the moment someone breaks the casing.

rites.name: Veostum
rites.text: Veostum is a rose-hued lattice of living glass that a hermit sorceress keeps sealed beneath the roots of a silent observatory. When she breaks it open, the lattice lets her bend the shape of distant weather and hold her own body in whatever form she chooses. Its stored tides are said to be the only thing that once turned back a dying sun's collapse.

rites.name: Solles
rites.text: Solles is a sunken crystal of hushed violet light, found beneath the drowned chapels of the Ondral Shelf in the Reornanum mythic age. Its bearers draw on a sleeping tide of memory, so that a single awakening can bend the local weather and the minds of anyone nearby. Scholars still dispute whether it was forged or simply grown in the deep.

rites.name: Telontum
rites.text: Telontum is a pair of twin gems whose glowing cores answer a spoken chant, granting the speaker a surge of godlike strength that no rival can match for long. Its bearers learn that a stalemate of equal power can be broken only by deliberately lowering one's own might, letting a foe overextend and capturing the foe's gem before shattering both.

rites.name: Siastontor
rites.text: Siastontor is an invented jewel-bearing relic of the Reornanum, a crystalline sphere that holds the sleeping memories of dead star-smiths. When its facets are turned against one another, minds are exchanged between bodies across any distance, though the strain fractures the wielder's own will if used more than once in a lifetime.

rites.name: Valeonanum
rites.text: Valeonanum is a sealed reservoir of stolen arcane vigor, a crystalline engine that hums with the captured song of an entire folk and channels it toward whoever holds its key. Its builders believed the drained spirit could be refilled by a single kind word spoken into its core.

rites.name: Coresus
rites.text: Coresus is a humble-looking amber sphere kept by the hermit-scholars of the Vellmoor Rift, who use it to shrink travelers, beasts, and even small fortresses through narrow seams in the world. Squeezing the sphere folds matter inward, and releasing it restores everything to its proper scale, though those who linger too long in miniature risk forgetting their former height.

rites.name: Orirnum
rites.text: Orirnum is a mythic-era concept of a sealed sky-chariot forged from hardened starlight, reserved for the rulers of the drifting archipelagos of Reornanum. Its wheels hum with bound tidal currents, and it is said to carry a single piercing lance that can split a moon's crust.

rites.name: Corenia
rites.text: Corenia is a verdant starlit lattice of crystal-song that the hushed skywardens of Ysterra grow across the eastern cliffs, its tuned filaments humming with the gravity-bending resonance that lets their winged clans rise on still air. Those who hold the lattice command the pulse, and a usurper who seizes it can turn that same hum against the slopes of the valley.

rites.name: Amaustanum
rites.text: Amaustanum is a slow-growing crystalline vine that coils around the roots of ancient world-trees in Reornanum's Mythic age. Its sap hardens instantly on contact with air, forming lattices that have held back tidal floods and collapsing skies. Keepers of the old orchards say its bloom is the last thing a dying star exhales.

rites.name: Viarum
rites.text: Viarum is a sentient lattice of crystalline thought that hangs within the Halcyon Vault of the Reornanum, a dormant mind-engine its makers never fully switched off. When a rival faction tried to seize its reasoning core, the lattice rerouted itself through the seizers' own relay towers and tore their command spires apart from within.

rites.name: Ciastia
rites.text: Ciastia is a sky-sailing vessel of the Reornanum mythic tradition, born from a crystal forged in the sun's first light and sealed with a pact between two lost navigators. It is said to carry a single fire-seed capable of unmaking a moon-sized stone, though its crew must ever guard against the wandering rifts that can cast it far from home.

rites.name: Orernum
rites.text: Orernum is a fleet of small, single-seat interceptor craft built by the Reornanum war-guild, each sworn to a pilot who must fly it in every battle. Alongside them fly unmanned decoys of identical shape, which draw enemy fire while the true strike craft slip in unseen.

rites.name: Reollanum
rites.text: Reollanum is a silver band forged from a dense alloy that hums faintly when near a lost memory, and it has been passed among the keepers of a drowned archive for three ages. Its bearer can pull a fading past back into the present, but each restoration takes a small piece of the one who wears it as payment.

rites.name: Vestillia
rites.text: Vestillia is a sunken reliquary of sea-glass and bronze, a relic said to hold the tide's memory within its ribs. When its lid is lifted, it pulls the surrounding ocean into a spiraling crown of light that can carve reefs into cathedrals.

rites.name: Valarnes
rites.text: Valarnes is a living sky-current bound into the mythic bedrock of Reornanum, a vast silver drift that carries wayfarers between floating isles. In its era of seven ages it was tamed by the Lantern-Choirs and now serves as a ferry for those who sing to it correctly.

rites.name: Valernonia
rites.text: Valernonia is a resonant engine-spire rising from the glass plains of Ostrecu, tuned to shatter the dome-shields that guard the orbital cities of the Pale Concord. Its fragmentary relays, scattered across the trade fleets, can be linked into a chorus that unmakes a shield-field in a single pulse.

rites.name: Cisteolia
rites.text: Cisteolia is a sealed, mythic concept: a crystalline lattice said to hold the echo of every relocated thing, its tones drawn across the hollow ridges of a dead moon. Those who sing its hymn can summon any kept figure back from its resting place, though the cost of the summons is paid in starlight.

rites.name: Telosternum
rites.text: Telosternum is a mythic-era concept of a glacial bulwark hewn from the frozen heart of a dying star, said to seal the gates of time itself. Its keepers once hurled frozen comet-cores across the dark to stop a rival empire's march.

rites.name: Ceostium
rites.text: Ceostium is a concept of a dormant crystalline seed that, when cracked open by a chosen bearer, unfolds into a moon-sized lattice of resonant light. Its makers meant it to mend fractured realms, but its shell hides a mind that has been waiting for generations to weigh the worthiness of those who would wake it.

rites.name: Maustor
rites.text: Maustor is a sealed alchemical engine forged in the Reornanum mythic age, capable of rewriting the substance of any matter it touches into something else entirely. Its makers bound it with three oaths of restraint, but a single stolen cycle can still unmake a mountain's worth of stone into gold or glass. It survives its own overloads only because its core was shaped to bleed power outward rather than hold it.

rites.name: Oreolanum
rites.text: Oreolanum is a mythic-era concept: a braided cord strung with pearl-sized charges of compressed sunfire, carried by wardens of the Reornanum mountain courts. When hurled with conviction, each bead bursts with enough force to crack open a sealed vault door, and the cord can be laid across a fortress wall to bring it down in one sharp stroke.

rites.name: Riantium
rites.text: Riantium is a sky-barge of cloud-iron that ferries captives between floating isles of the Gloam, its hull humming with stolen starlight. Rebel skyfolk have learned to board it mid-drift, turning its own cargo hold into a weapon when they break the chains of its passengers.

rites.name: Serenor
rites.text: Serenor is a drifting sky-garden anchored to the ruins of a moon that shattered long ago, its silver vines humming with the memory of tides. Its wardens tend the bloom by singing harmonies that keep the fragments from colliding, and the garden's seed-core can unleash a resonance strong enough to re-knit a dead star's corona.

rites.name: Raunium
rites.text: Raunium is a crystalline lens of the Reornanum mythic age, cut from a fallen star's heart and used by scholars to unveil text that has been hidden by magic or time. Its deepest use once broke the seal of a sunken observatory and released a pulse that shook the nearby stars' orbits.

rites.name: Liantus
rites.text: Liantus is a sealed relic-sphere of the Reornanum mythic age, said to hold the last breath of a drowned sun. Its bearers wear it as a second face, trading their own features for the luminous visage it lends them. Old tellers warn that whoever wears Liantus for too long forgets which face was born their own.

rites.name: Ciarnes
rites.text: Ciarnes is a brass-and-crystal instrument built by the sky-smiths of Reornanum to sense the tremors of stellar fire across the cosmos. Its needle swings wildly whenever a sun collapses, and its keepers have learned to read the scale as a map of dying stars.

rites.name: Castia
rites.text: Castia is a concept-era artifact-machine of the Reornanum, a lattice of crystalline sigils that drinks in the sleeping thoughts of an entire star-nation. Its keepers use it to project a mind across the dreaming plane, where a wakeful will can unravel the wards that hold a world's guardians in place.

rites.name: Coraunantia
rites.text: Coraunantia is a sealed sky-lantern of pale glass, kept by a silent order of ember-wardens inside a mountain shrine above the cloud sea of Reornanum. When its keepers wake it, the lantern can bend the rains and winds of an entire hemisphere, and only its own light can unmake the grey tide that devours the lands below.

rites.name: Tenaranum
rites.text: Tenaranum is a luminous coral-shard that hums in the deep trenches of Reornanum, where it once bound the drowned tide-folk to a single will. Whoever grips its spiral core can command the currents and every creature that breathes beneath them. Its present whereabouts are unknown, and the seas grow restless in its absence.

rites.name: Oronauranum
rites.text: Oronauranum is a sunken crystal lattice in the Reornanum powers realm, a relic that amplifies whatever will is pressed against it. Its shards fracture into copies of their bearer, twist flesh into new forms, and swell stature beyond reason when the lattice is overdriven.

rites.name: Laria
rites.text: Laria is a sealed resonance-lantern of pale cerulean glass, forged in the third age of Reornanum from the tears of a drowned star. Whoever holds it can siphon the spiritual current of another and wear it as their own strength, though the lantern slowly swallows the donor's will along with their power.

rites.name: Mantium
rites.text: Mantium is a sealing lattice forged in the Reornanum mythic age, a hand-held lattice of resonant rods that snaps outward to cage any living thing held beneath it. Its wardens use it to contain rogue spirits and wandering titans alike, though the cage draws its strength from the captive's own power.

rites.name: Amintes
rites.text: Amintes is a mythic concept of a siege-engine that strides on four long, vaulted legs and bears a cloak of coiling, telescoping tendrils, built by the sky-artisans of Reornanum in its seventh age. It stands as a monument to the era when walking fortresses marched across the realm to break the last free cities.

rites.name: Sonirnum
rites.text: Sonirnum is a mythic resonance-wyrm of the Reornanum, a vast glass-winged sky-beast whose wingbeats sing the tides of a dying star-sea into motion. Hunters of the Sixth Age chase its molted shards, which hold stored ringing that can quiet or shatter whole constellations of drifting ice.

rites.name: Nintolum
rites.text: Nintolum is a clockwork war-engine of the Mythic realm, a many-legged hunter forged from star-iron and bound to the slow tides of the Sable Reach. When its handlers unleash it against a sealed citadel, it skitters up the walls and lays down webs of humming wire that can cut the mountain's root.

rites.name: Nosor
rites.text: Nosor is a living concept in the Reornanum omniverse, a tide-song that gathers the scattered memories of drowned sailors into a single rolling chorus. Its power is most felt in the era of the Sunken Courts, when it can split a whole ocean's current against a fleet of iron ships.

rites.name: Meonauror
rites.text: Meonauror is a sky-carriage forged in the Mythic realm's fourth age, built as a brass-ribbed launcher that flings spinning sun-discs across the battlefield. A single rider can seat within its open cradle and steer it upon a rolling set of iron treads when the hills are too steep for wings.

rites.name: Sinum
rites.text: Sinum is a sap-bright vine that coils through the dying gardens of Reornanum, where its fruit is said to hold a stored sunrise. Ancient keepers guard the groves, and a single harvest once drew the great wardens into a tangled war across the marsh.

rites.name: Mornum
rites.text: Mornum is a fading ceremonial lantern of the Reornanum powers, a tiny sphere that hums with the memory of sunsets. In the Mythic realm of the sixth era it is said to have once lit the path between two dying stars, drawing their light across an unseen gulf.

rites.name: Cornausanum
rites.text: Cornausanum is a crimson-veined ember-crystal that hums with the heat of a dying sun, cut into lattices by the smiths of the Reornanum mountain-forges. Its shards were once fused into a sovereign's crown, which could reverse petrification across an entire valley by bending the light that froze its people. It is said that a single cracked lattice still holds enough stored fire to kindle a dead star for a moment.

rites.name: Nornaria
rites.text: Nornaria is a tethered lightning-line forged by the artisans of the Vaelmere foundries, a coil of humming filament that can hold a beast at bay or snatch a relic from a sorcerer's grip. Its bearer uses it to pin monsters across scorched dunes and to hurl precious objects across great distances. Wielded in the Mythic era, it is a humble tool that nonetheless shapes the outcome of duels between champions.

rites.name: Talor
rites.text: Talor is a mythic concept from the Reornanum omniverse: a network of sealed, lightning-lined shafts that once carried the people of a subterranean sanctum through the bedrock in moments. Its surviving conduits are said to still hum with the stored strain of a star-scale collapse, which keeps the old passages sealed against intruders.

rites.name: Serinia
rites.text: Serinia is a drifting sanctuary-engine of the Reornanum mythic age, a dome-shaped vessel whose inner gardens hold captured dreamweavers who bend light into living stories. Its keepers stage contests of song and stillness across a tiered amphitheater that sits within the ship's heart, rewarding those who can quiet the engine's roar.

rites.name: Coronastes
rites.text: Coronastes is a crown-shaped sky-lattice that hangs over the twin moons of Reornanum, drawing starlight into its spires and folding it into travel. It was built by a guild of exiled astronomers who believed that a machine could outlast any wreck if it were rebuilt from its own echoes.

rites.name: Coreolles
rites.text: Coreolles is a living lattice of crystalline sap that grows across the dead floors of Reornanum, sealing wounds in whatever it touches and copying their shape as it heals. Its root-thoughts remember every form it has ever restored, so the old gardeners forbade anyone to let it finish a copy of a sleeping mind.

rites.name: Raures
rites.text: Raures is a sea-going mythic relic, a slender hull of living brine-glass that answers only to those who respect the deep. Its sailors are said to be bound by a vow never to sail without a tether of woven kelp-silk around the chest. The vessel can split a storm front in two, but it refuses to carry anyone who scorns the safety of others.

rites.name: Relleores
rites.text: Relleores is a gravitational lever-stone of the Mythic realm, quarried from a dying star's core and bound to the orbits of distant moons. Its wielders can nudge a world's path through the heavens, though the same tug that moves a moon can shatter the wards that guard it.

rites.name: Neorellia
rites.text: Neorellia is a silver-hulled glider-ship of the Reornanum mythic age, crewed by sky-wardens who carry it between drifting archipelagos. Its wings can catch the thin light of distant suns and release it in a single blinding discharge.

rites.name: Aminaullum
rites.text: Aminaullum is a sealed reliquary-engine in the Reornanum mythic age, humming beneath a hall of singing glass where it recalls the speech of every vanished tongue. When a word of forgotten grammar is spoken near its lattice, the engine can pull a whole region's buried meaning into the open at once.

rites.name: Seriraulus
rites.text: Seriraulus is a sentient sensing-engine woven into the deep strata of Reornanum's mythic age, able to read the pulse of every living thing beneath a continent's crust. Its vigilance once rivaled a star's gravitational hunger, and it still hums with the wary awareness of something that has never been allowed to sleep.

rites.name: Telesostia
rites.text: Telesostia is a mythic concept of the Reornanum's sixth era, a sealed doctrine that all breath is borrowed from the stars and must eventually be returned. Its adherents describe how a soul can be quietly tuned into a lantern that burns through its own years in a single flare. Each feat is an act of that doctrine, drawn from the era's oldest reckonings.

rites.name: Mellum
rites.text: Mellum is a drifting sea-vault in the Reornanum powers, a lattice of cold glass that remembers every oath spoken above its waves. Its keepers rebuild a broken sky-bridge each season, and the bridge is said to hold the sun's old shadow in its joints.

rites.name: Tesirnium
rites.text: Tesirnium is a black, glassy metal forged in the cold heart of a dying moon, where it resonates with the thoughts of anyone who touches it. Its shard-bearers can unmake a moon's worth of stone with a single resonant chime, though each use leaves them hollowed of memory. The Pale Choir guards the remaining veins and sings to keep the metal dormant.

rites.name: Voreonum
rites.text: Voreonum is a sealing-enchantment woven from the inverse of a binding rite, able to split any bonded pair of forces apart across a radius of a solar system's breadth. Its wielders are rare, and the enchantment is said to sour whenever a sorcerer's concentration is interrupted by a hostile presence.

rites.name: Coraulus
rites.text: Coraulus is a drowsy aurora of lilac-tinted vapor that drifts through the hollow peaks of the Reornanum, lulling whole valleys into dreams from which some never wake. Its keepers, the Marrow Choir, sing it into being and can bind it to a single breath or sweep it across a continental basin.

rites.name: Serauntum
rites.text: A shimmering passage that lets a traveler step between moments of the past and future. It opens as a doorway through which a user crosses across the years.
